title: Who frees this?
description:
Model ownership with raw pointers and make every rule explicit.

```
library owns 3 books
reader borrows "Dune" (a non-owning pointer)
library removes "Dune": reader's pointer is cleared
all books freed: 3 new, 3 delete
```
hints: Comment every pointer with who owns it: "owning" or "borrowed" (lesson 4.04).
The library keeps a list of readers and, in `remove`, clears any reader whose pointer equals the book being deleted.
requirements: `class Library` owns `Book*`s made with `new`, and deletes them in its destructor.
A `Reader` holds a borrowed `Book*`; when the library removes a book, it tells readers to clear it.
Count `new` and `delete` and check they match at the end.
stretch: Rewrite it with `std::unique_ptr` in the library and plain pointers in readers, and see which code disappears. (`std::unique_ptr` is lesson 5.02; look it up in `<memory>` if you get here first.)
